actions.description: Render images for Figma file nodes.
actions.name: render-images

file_key.description: The file key to render images from. Example: "UzYlOaPNPL2c7zmHCEljOs"

format.description: Image output format. Defaults to png.

svg_outline_text.description: Whether text elements are rendered as outlines in SVGs. Defaults to true.

svg_include_id.description: Whether to include id attributes for all SVG elements. Defaults to false.

svg_include_node_id.description: Whether to include node id attributes for all SVG elements. Defaults to false.

svg_simplify_stroke.description: Whether to simplify inside/outside strokes in SVGs. Defaults to true.

contents_only.description: Whether content that overlaps the node should be excluded. Defaults to true.

use_absolute_bounds.description: Use full dimensions of the node regardless of cropping. Defaults to false.

version.description: A specific version ID to use. Omit for the current version.

actions.description: Update dev resources linked to Figma nodes.
actions.name: update-dev-resources

id.description: Unique identifier of the dev resource. Example: "devres_123"

name.description: The name of the dev resource.

url.description: The URL of the dev resource.

dev_resources.description: A list of dev resources that you want to update.

links_updated.description: Ids for dev resources that were successfully updated.

errors.description: Errors for dev resources that could not be updated.

actions.name: update-variables

actions.description: Update a webhook in Figma
actions.name: update-webhook

webhook_id.description: The ID of the webhook to update. Example: "123456789"

event_type.description: The type of event that will trigger this webhook to fire.

endpoint.description: The HTTP endpoint that will receive a POST request when the event triggers. Max length 2048 characters.

passcode.description: String that will be passed back to your webhook endpoint to verify that it is being called by Figma. Max length 100 characters.

status.description: State to put the webhook in. The webhook cannot be put into an error state this way.

description.description: User-provided description or name for the webhook. Max length 140 characters. Providing an empty string will delete the description.
